card.proactivePrompt: Is this kitchen as authentic as it looks?
card.factHeader: The Langham kitchen was a custom-built, working set.

factBeats.text: The intense kitchen scenes were filmed on a specially constructed set at Ealing Studios, rather than in The Langham's actual kitchens.
The production designed and built the set to be a fully operational kitchen, complete with working equipment.
Chef consultant Marcus Wareing was instrumental in the set's design, drawing on his experience building real kitchens.
To make the actors appear genuinely exhausted, the stoves on set were turned on full, creating real heat and sweat.

claim_evidence.beat: The production designed and built the set to be a fully operational kitchen, complete with working equipment.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: The set was a fully functioning kitchen built specially for the movie. It could have been picked up and moved into any restaurant. My job was to make it work as a real kitchen.

claim_evidence.beat: Chef consultant Marcus Wareing was instrumental in the set's design, drawing on his experience building real kitchens.
claim_evidence.supporting_passage: Not really, I've done it before, I've built my own kitchens . . .
